dropbear-ssh.name: Dropbear SSH
dropbear-ssh.author: Akshay
dropbear-ssh.description: On-demand SSH/SFTP server (dropbear, repackaged from notmarek/kindle-usbnetlite) over your existing WiFi — no USB networking needed. Launching opens a status app with a Start/Stop button (talks to a small loopback-only HTTP bridge on-device, no external server) showing the connect command and password while running. A random password is generated on install and printed in the KPM log; set your own any time by editing /mnt/us/usbnetlite/etc/ssh_password and restarting the server. Verified working on Kindle PaperWhite 4 (kernel 4.1.x, 2018-2022-era hardware). Ships a second binary build for newer/older devices per upstream's own release split, selected automatically by kernel version at install time — that second build is UNTESTED beyond confirming it executes; it is not confirmed to correctly serve SSH sessions on its target hardware.
